description: This file defines the MultipartCopy class, which manages multipart copy operations in AWS S3 using the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for creating, uploading, and completing multipart uploads, as well as handling source metadata and source-specific configurations.

classes.name: MultipartCopy
classes.description: Handles multipart copying of objects within S3, including methods for initializing, creating, and managing multipart copy uploads.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultipartCopy instance with S3 client, source info, and configuration options.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Alias for the upload method to start the multipart copy process.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Returns configuration for multipart upload command workflow, including initiate, upload, and complete commands.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Generates the commands required for uploading parts of the object in multipart copy, based on source size and part size.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Creates and returns the data array for a specific part of the upload, including range and source info.

methods.name: extractETag
methods.description: Extracts the ETag from the upload result, useful for verifying copied parts.

methods.name: getSourceMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the source object.

methods.name: getSourceSize
methods.description: Returns the content length of the source object.

methods.name: getSourceMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves and caches the metadata of the source object.

methods.name: fetchSourceMetadata
methods.description: Fetches source object metadata via headObject call to S3, considering source modification details.

methods.name: getInputSource
methods.description: Processes raw input source string or array to normalize the source path, handling ARNs and URL decoding.
